name: M1 frontend: "Email accounts" panel in Account settings (connect, list, disconnect)
description:
MILESTONE 1 (front-end half) — the user-facing half of "associate a Gmail account to a user". Ships with the M1 backend so the milestone is demoable.

Profile chosen: VueDeveloper — this is Vue 3 component work in the existing client.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. Extend client/src/components/security/AccountSettings.vue with an "Email accounts" section below the existing Email field. Keep the existing layout, style (daisyUI classes) and the current Theme/Avatar/Email/Reset-password block untouched.
2. The section must show: list of connected Gmail accounts (address, status badge, connected date), a "Connect Gmail" button, and a per-account "Disconnect" action with a confirm dialog (reuse ConfirmDialog.vue).
3. Add the client API module methods (client/src/api/modules/) for the M1 endpoints: list accounts, get login url, disconnect.
4. Connect flow: request the login url, redirect the browser to Google, and on return re-fetch the account list and show a toast.
5. Show a clear error state when a token expired or access was revoked, with a "Reconnect" action.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- A logged-in user clicks Connect Gmail, completes consent, and lands back on Account settings with the account listed — no page reload required.
- Disconnect asks for confirmation, then removes the account from the list.
- No token value is ever rendered or logged in the browser.
- Component works on the existing light/dark themes and does not break the rest of Account settings.
